unit: Work and Organization Studies Group (MIT Sloan)

labs.lab_name: MIT Sloan Work and Organization Studies Group
labs.location: MIT Sloan School of Management, 100 Main Street, Cambridge, MA 02142
labs.research_summary: Studies work, the organizations people work in and the institutions around them, drawing on social psychology, sociology, history, anthropology, labor economics and industrial relations.
labs.notes: Academic group entry: member_count left null because an academic group is department-like, not a lab. No group head, group email or group-specific jobs page is shown on the group's pages; location and phone are the MIT Sloan school-wide footer details. The worklist's people page is the whole Sloan faculty directory and its about and careers pages are school-wide; they say nothing specific about this group, so no join page is recorded (the careers page only points to MIT staff openings and Sloan faculty openings). The group's about page says WOS was formed in 2014 by merging the Organization Studies Group with IWER. Its Faculty & Research Centers page lists standing faculty, emeritus faculty, lecturers, other academic staff (two postdoctoral associates and an adjunct professor) and affiliated faculty; no one is named as group head. That page lists seven affiliated centers, recorded below, and faculty bios on it name two more units led by WOS faculty (Behavioral Research Lab, Sloan Sustainability Initiative), also recorded. The MIT System Dynamics Group, named in an affiliated faculty bio, is a separate Sloan academic group and is not recorded here.

Listed on the WOS Faculty & Research Centers page as a center its faculty are affiliated with; no lead or blurb shown; its site was not read. Depth pass 2026-11-22: Null: gcgj.mit.edu now serves IWER's Good Jobs Resources page at every address tried (the home page and the people link return the same page), so the initiative shows no roster or named lead of its own and appears folded into IWER; IWER's roster was not used.
